description: Fix response-schema drift between the Erebor OpenAPI snapshot and the live API, verified against api.erebor.bank. (1) Program.billing_deposit_account_id is declared required but is omitted from MANAGED program responses -> make optional. (2) Program responses include an undocumented program_type field (observed value MANAGED) -> add it. (3) Onboarding.disclosures is declared required but is omitted from every onboarding response (list/get/create/update) -> make optional. (4) Onboarding responses include an undocumented rejection_reason field -> add it. (5) The user-supplied `description` field is declared as a non-nullable string on every counterparty address/account output schema and on Transaction, but the API returns null when no description was set -> make nullable on all five output schemas. (6) BookTransferStatus omits the CREATED state returned immediately after creating a transfer -> add it. (7) TransactionFrom.url is declared required, but historical external-source transactions omit it -> make optional. These were reported upstream in .ai-workspace/erebor-openapi-spec-issues.md.

value.description: Program type classification. Observed value: `MANAGED`. Undocumented in the OpenAPI snapshot but returned by the live API.
Reason the onboarding was rejected, or null when not rejected. Undocumented in the OpenAPI snapshot but returned by the live API.
